synopsis: Volvo CE’s January 2023 Collision Mitigation System covered L110H–L260H wheel loaders and explicitly included the L200H High Lift [f1380]. Chapter 13 adds that the system was a factory-fit option, listing L200H High Lift alongside L150H, L180H, L220H and L260H; L110H and L120H eligibility required OptiShift [f10629]. Volvo’s April 2025 announcement subsequently covered new-generation loaders, including the L200 High Lift, but the supplied facts do not establish its Collision Mitigation System availability or its equivalence to the earlier L200H High Lift [f1385, f1380, f10629].

relations.note: Adds factory-fit status and model-specific eligibility details to the earlier system coverage.
